facts.text: for the Japanese restaurant scene where nobody takes their shoes off
facts.why: In the transcript the host demands shoes off and Donnie says neither are the rest of us, so the whole party refuses.
facts.fix: for the Japanese restaurant scene where Donnie and Nicky keep their shoes on

facts.text: Sonny Black's social club, where everyone drinks Scotch
facts.why: The transcript has Sonny telling Joe to give the humps another drink, but never names Scotch or a Rob Roy. Lefty is the one offered spritzers.
facts.fix: Sonny Black's social club, where Joe keeps the drinks coming

facts.why: No sweet tooth or cheesecake in the transcript. Sonny does tell Donnie in Florida that New York bread is like cake.
facts.fix: New York bread is like cake, says Sonny

facts.why: Lefty cooks coq au vin at Christmas and says the Brooklyn goombahs only know manicotti. Gravy, meatballs and braciole are never shown.
facts.fix: the goombah cooking Lefty swears he is above

vibe.verdict: A great looking Japanese restaurant with the shoes gag and the 'friend of mine' card, but the food leans on guesses instead of what Lefty really cooks.
missing: Fugazy diamond ring (the bar scene with Pandar)
Lefty's coq au vin Christmas dinner (his kitchen)
Sonny's gift of a live lion to Lefty (the lion print nod could point at this)
'A wiseguy never pays for his drinks' (Lefty)
Spritzers at the social club (Lefty's crew)
The Bertram boat Lefty dreams of (Florida trip)
ideas: Swap 'Lefty's Sunday gravy' for 'Lefty's coq au vin', with 'You think I cook like them goombahs in Brooklyn?' as the note.
Swap 'Social Club Rob Roy' for 'Social Club Spritzer', white wine and soda, since Lefty is offered one at the club.
Swap the 'Jade and pearls in the gift case are real' footer for 'Your diamond's a fugazy. Ours are not.', a nod to the ring scene.
Add 'A wiseguy never pays for his drinks' under the bar list in place of 'Not responsible for items in footwear'.
iconic: This is a friend of ours (Lefty's introduction)
changed: Footer 'Gratuity not included.' now 'Gratuity? Forget about it.'
